text_block_list.text:
"To have won so many plushies...! I am in 
awe of your masterful skill!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I took half, then? Fufu, 
my family will be thrilled.
choice_data_list:
Forget half, I'll give you the whole 
thing!

text_block_list.name: Durandal

text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. Well then, maybe 
I'll display one of them in my dorm room.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My heart flutters every time I look at 
this girl... Fufu!
